name: edit
description: Edit text as one tracked change set, all or nothing. Write plain text; **bold** *italic* allowed. Returns the changed lines and the new version.

base_version.description: version of your last read or edit

op.description: split: before find; merge: with the next block

find.description: exact text in the block; null = whole block

text.description: new text; a newline starts a new paragraph

style.description: for inserts: P, H1-H9, LI or a style name; null = like anchor

expect.description: current block text; only if base_version is old
